title: Family Picnic in Park, 1960s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white square snapshot from the early 1960s capturing a family gathering for a picnic in a sun-dappled public park. Men, women, and small children relax on blankets under the heavy shade of large trees, surrounded by coolers, picnic baskets, and beverage crates, illustrating everyday American leisure culture of the mid-20th century.
